name: Rusty Grate Pit

stealth.details: (expert), or 0 if the grate is open

disable: DC 18 Thievery check to harmlessly trigger the trap by nudging the gate or the dangling winch, or DC 24 Thievery check to stabilize the grate so it doesn't collapse.

items.name: Pitfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto the grate

---

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (20 bludgeoning damage). That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling.

Whether or not the creature Grabs an Edge, the rusty winch above crashes down atop the triggering creature, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage and dislodging its grip (DC 24 basic Reflex save save). The creature can still try to Grab an Edge again.

text: The rusty grate covers a pit that's 10 feet in diameter and 40 feet deep.
